title: Powers of Attorney Act 2014
why: General, enduring and supportive powers of attorney: making one, decision-making capacity, the attorney's duties, conflict transactions, VCAT's powers, and compensation for loss caused by an attorney's breach (s 77).

hand_saved_2026_11_07.original_not_kept_why: as the existing deposits do (the ACT Word files, the Gazette PDF): the converted text and the hashes of the original are kept, not the file

text.converter: vic_convert2.py (stdlib zipfile + ElementTree over word/document.xml; kept outside the repository), from 2026-11-07; the text first deposited on 2026-11-07 was made by vic_convert.py
text.conversion: The Word file was converted to UTF-8 plain text by Legalese Commons (vic_convert.py: stdlib zipfile and ElementTree over word/document.xml). The table of provisions, running heads and footers are dropped; the cover is kept as the file prints it (twice). Each provision starts on its own line with its number; paragraphs are indented two spaces a level; the register's marginal history notes are kept as "[Side note: ...]" lines before the provision they annotate; tables are "| a | b |" rows; Word equations are linearised in place. The endnotes (amendment history) are kept. Nothing else is changed.
known_conversion_artefacts: the cover (version number, title, number, version date) appears twice at the head, as in the Word file
the "Note" and "Example" labels stand on their own line, unindented, before their text
multi-line formulas set as indented paragraphs keep their brackets but lose their alignment

reconverted_2026_11_07.converter: vic_convert2.py, the same converter as vic_convert.py with one fix: Word <w:sym> characters with a code of F000 or more are kept
reconverted_2026_11_07.why: vic_convert.py dropped every <w:sym> character with a code of F000 or more. The register sets some characters that way in the Symbol font: F0D7 is its raised decimal point, F0B4 the multiplication sign, F02D the minus sign, F0B7 a bullet (and Wingdings boxes). In this Act only Wingdings boxes were lost: the three tick-boxes before the commencement options of the Schedule form.
reconverted_2026_11_07.what_changed: 3 lines of the body, and only the restored characters (12 characters added: 3 "[ ]", each with its space): the options "immediately", "on this date: (insert date)" and "on this occasion: (insert occasion)" under "I specify that this power of attorney begins:" in the Schedule (Form of General Non-enduring Power of Attorney, s 7). No number, decimal point, multiplication or minus sign was lost in this Act. Line numbers are unchanged. The notice header is unchanged. Checked by a diff of the old text against the new.
reconverted_2026_11_07.formula_prefix: none used: the Act has no embedded equation objects or images, so no formula marker is written
